overview.title: Partner portal
overview.description: Shipments suppliers on CANG handed to {company}: pickups, transit, delivery and problems.
overview.welcomeBody: Your logistics partner account is created. Complete your profile — services, modes and coverage — so CANG can approve it and suppliers can book you.
overview.pendingBody: Suppliers can assign shipments to you once CANG has reviewed your company (usually within one working day).
overview.profileBody: Add your services, transport modes and countries so suppliers pick you for the right shipments.
overview.problemsHint: Failed pickups or deliveries and shipments on hold.
overview.pickupsHint: Booked shipments waiting to be collected from the factory.

list.title: Shipments
list.description: Every shipment assigned to you. Update statuses as the goods move — buyer and supplier see them instantly.
list.searchPlaceholder: Shipment, order, tracking or container no., company
list.emptyHint: Suppliers assign shipments when they book you for an order.

profile.title: Profile & coverage
profile.description: What suppliers see when they choose a logistics partner.
profile.pendingBody: CANG checks new partners before suppliers can book them. Keep this profile complete to speed it up.
profile.aboutHint: Fleet, warehouses, lanes you specialise in, certifications.
profile.countriesHint: Two-letter codes separated by commas, e.g. VN, CN, US.

integrations.title: Integrations & API
integrations.description: Connect your TMS or carrier accounts so statuses reach buyers without typing them twice.
integrations.apiHint: Create a key with the shipments scopes above and send it as a bearer token.
integrations.apiExample: Report a delivery from your system:
integrations.apiStatuses: status is one of the CANG statuses (READY_TO_PICK, PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, DELIVERY_FAILED…). Problems need reason_code; deliveries need receiver_name. external_id makes retries safe.
integrations.webhookHint: Paste these URLs into your GHN / GHTK account so their status changes update CANG shipments with the same tracking number.
integrations.tokenCreatedHint: Copy the URLs now — the token is shown only once.
integrations.tokenHidden: A token is set. Rotate it to see new URLs (the old token stops working).
integrations.credentialsHint: Your own GHN / GHTK API tokens enable “Sync with carrier” on shipments with their tracking numbers.

team.title: Team
team.description: Dispatchers manage shipments and the team; drivers (Staff role) can only update statuses.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: New bookings, cancellations and changes on the shipments you handle.
notifications.emptyHint: You will be notified when a supplier assigns a shipment to you.
